title: Idilla & Fall V2 — Italian Ceramics For Contemporary Specification
bodyHtml:
Idilla Structure paired with Square basin — an integrated composition that reduces visual fragmentation within the bathroom space.

Idilla & Fall V2 — Italian Ceramics for Contemporary Specification

Contemporary bathroom specification increasingly calls for clarity — products that resolve form, material, and integration without excess. Within this context, Italian ceramic continues to play a central role, valued for its durability, refinement, and ability to support both expressive and restrained design outcomes.

The Idilla Series and Fall V2 Undercounter basins represent two distinct but complementary approaches to ceramic specification. Each is shaped by clear design intent and conceived to support real-world planning across residential and light commercial projects, where longevity, consistency, and visual discipline matter.

Idilla Square basin — soft geometry and generous proportions translated into a refined, architectural presence.

Idilla Series — Sculptural Form with Specification Clarity

The Idilla Series by Alice Ceramica introduces a sculptural ceramic language defined by soft geometry and generous proportions. Rather than relying on applied detail, Idilla’s character is established through form — allowing the series to sit comfortably within a wide range of architectural settings.

Across its basin formats, Idilla maintains a consistent language that supports cohesive specification. Compact circular forms suit smaller spaces, while oval and square variants offer greater surface presence for ensuites and feature bathrooms — allowing designers to stay within one series while responding to different spatial requirements.

Hand-finished in Italy, each basin balances visual expression with everyday usability, making Idilla suitable for projects where aesthetic intent must be matched by practical performance.

Idilla Circle basin — detail view showing ceramic surface quality and edge resolution supporting long-term durability and visual consistency.

Colour & Finish — Planning Flexibility Across Project Types

Colour and finish selection plays an important role in specification, particularly where projects need flexibility across briefs or client preferences. Idilla supports this through a considered finish approach, allowing designers to work within a cohesive ceramic language while adapting to varied design narratives.

Alongside core finishes suitable for broad application, Idilla is available via Specially Made Order in an extended palette of 12 organic colours — eight matte and four gloss. Muted matte tones such as Lemon, Rose, Ash, and Coffee provide subtle variation within restrained schemes, while gloss finishes including Myrtle, Tabasco, and Honey offer greater saturation where a more expressive approach is required.

This range allows colour to operate as a planning tool rather than a limitation, without requiring a shift away from a preferred product family.

Specially Made Order lead times are approximately 14–16 weeks.

Idilla Oval basin — compact form expressed through colour, supporting flexible application across varied spatial contexts.

Idilla Structure & Column — Monolithic Ceramic for Powder Rooms

The Idilla Structure extends the series beyond individual components into a more integrated architectural expression. Fully ceramic and hand-formed, the structure mirrors the geometry of the basins to create a resolved, monolithic composition.

Now available in Gloss White, the Idilla Column offers a compact, architectural solution designed to anchor powder rooms with confidence. Its small footprint and continuous ceramic form allow it to function as both basin and object — expressive without excess.

For designers seeking clarity and restraint, these pieces reduce visual fragmentation within the bathroom space. Basin and structure read as a single element rather than a collection of parts, making the combination well suited to powder rooms, hospitality environments, and feature bathrooms where proportion and material presence are central to the spatial experience.

Idilla Column — a sculptural ceramic element conceived to define powder rooms through proportion, material, and form.

Fall V2 Undercounter Series — Quiet Integration Through Refinement

The Fall V2 60 and 80 Undercounter basins by Azzurra Ceramica offer a contrasting approach — one defined by restraint, integration, and subtle refinement. Designed to sit quietly beneath the benchtop, Fall V2 prioritises clean lines and uninterrupted surfaces within contemporary bathroom environments.

The V2 evolution refines the original Fall design through softened internal geometry and a discreetly resolved overflow, integrated without a visible hole ring. These updates enhance both the visual calm of the basin and the overall coherence of the benchtop installation.

Defined by a narrow projection and generous internal width, Fall V2 supports efficient spatial planning while maintaining a refined ceramic presence — well suited to residential, multi-residential, and hospitality applications where integration and proportion are key considerations.

Fall 80 V2 Undercounter basin — defined by generous internal width and a narrow projection, supporting clean benchtop resolution and efficient spatial planning.

Specification Support & Availability

While both collections are designed to support long-horizon specification, selected Idilla and Fall V2 products are also available from stock in core finishes for projects requiring early samples or smaller quantities. Stock availability includes Matte and Gloss White for Idilla and Fall V2 basins, and Matte Black for the Idilla Structure.

For specification support — including samples, technical documentation, and project guidance — call (02) 9601 1948.
